PROP-5a6a79d5-post-003.text: Transactions must be processed in sequential order within a block.
PROP-5a6a79d5-post-003.assertion: forall block, i < j: exec_order(tx[i]) < exec_order(tx[j])

locations.note: Transactions are committed sequentially via receipts.push(); sequential ordering is enforced by the executor calling execute_transaction in order
